verdict.rationale: OpenCode's own plan agent analyzes the user's codebase and returns suggestions without modifying it, and a read-only explore agent investigates codebases. That is direct, in-product AI insight over the user's code. The story's broader 'my data' scope (non-code data, structured insight or analytics output) is not documented, and no independent or hands-on evidence confirms suggestion quality. missing for 10: insights over non-code user data, documented insight or report formats, independent corroboration of suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: This agent is useful when you want the LLM to analyze code, suggest changes, or create plans without making any actual modifications to your codebase.
Use the plan agent to analyze code and review suggestions without making any code changes.
A fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases. Cannot modify files.
